title: The Good Table
summary: Giving a neighbourhood restaurant a generous new voice.
cardAlt: The Good Table menu and table setting
tagline: A generous new voice. Always a seat at the table.
introduction: A neighbourhood restaurant with good food, good company, and a brand that makes everyone feel like a regular.

heroArtwork.alt: Tomato vine illustration created for The Good Table

heroImage.alt: A welcoming table set for lunch at The Good Table

challenge.heading: A local favourite. Ready for its next chapter.
challenge.copy: The Good Table had all the ingredients of a neighbourhood institution: seasonal food, familiar faces, and a generous welcome. Its identity needed to express that warmth with the same care as the kitchen.

contribution.heading: Good food. Good company. One distinctive voice.
contribution.copy: We built the brand around a simple invitation: there’s always a seat. A confident serif wordmark, hand-drawn produce, and a warm, tactile palette bring that idea to life across menus, matchboxes, and every little touch at the table.

outcome.heading: A brand that feels like being welcomed in.
outcome.copy: A cohesive identity that carries the restaurant’s generous spirit from the first impression to the last little detail. Recognisable on the street. Memorable at the table.
